title: WEBINAR: Porting, Analysing & Optimising AI Models onto Edge GPUs
gist: Promotional announcement for a 11 November 2026 Imagination Technologies webinar, led by Director of Engineering Mario Florea, on porting, profiling and optimising AI models (using Qwen 3.5) on edge GPUs; its substantive argument is that TOPS figures alone don't determine edge AI performance and programmable GPUs help cope with evolving models.

insights.claim: Turning modern AI models into efficient edge applications requires more than hardware with an impressive TOPS figure; developers must understand how models behave on target devices and where performance is lost.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Headline TOPS is a weak proxy for real edge AI performance, shifting value to software stacks.
